But four defects survive. (1) The block's `run id : <the representative run, from the summary's test and seed columns>` violates the registered SHAPE in _shared/handoff-vocabulary.md line 108 ("Whatever identifies one run for this team, per the profile's Run identity fact"), which both sibling emitters obey verbatim (dv-sim-log-first-error:205, dv-minimal-reproducer:325). (2) `unaccounted : <count>, derived as total minus pass minus fail` is unconditional in the block, so on a summary that does report not-started/skipped (which step 1 instructs you to extract) it prints a phantom count equal to the unrun count already shown in `totals`; the verification checklist only checks the label, not the branch.
